Ollama Context Length: Set It and Verify the Running Model

Set options.num_ctx on a native Ollama request, then inspect /api/ps for the exact running model. In our Ollama 0.40.18 checks, requests for 2,048 and 8,192 tokens produced matching reported context values. A request setting alone does not prove long-context recall or available memory.

Tested and source-checked November 27, 2026

  1. Set context at the scope you intend
  2. Two values verified on the running model
  3. Build a request and read your snapshot
  4. If the value is missing or different
  5. Sources and complete evidence

Set context at the scope you intend

For a controlled request, set options.num_ctx on Ollama’s native chat or generate endpoint. A Modelfile can save a model-specific default with PARAMETER num_ctx; OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH configures the server process’s default. Check the current version and actual loaded model rather than assuming every installation has the same default.

Configuration and observation are different steps
ScopeExampleHow to verify
One native API requestoptions.num_ctx: 8192Inspect /api/ps immediately after that request.
A model defaultPARAMETER num_ctx 4096 in its ModelfileCreate the intended alias and load that exact model.
A server defaultOLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=4096 ollama serveConfirm which server process and port your client reaches.

In our fixture, the saved model and server default were 4,096. Native requests asking for 2,048 and 8,192 both changed the running value reported by /api/ps. This verifies the observed request override for that model and version; it does not establish every configuration precedence rule.

Two values verified on the running model

We used Ollama 0.40.18 with Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct Q4_K_M on an M3 Pro with 18 GiB physical memory. Before each request we unloaded this test model, then sent a short synthetic prompt with temperature 0 and at most 16 generated tokens.

November 27, 2026 · native chat followed by /api/ps
Requested num_ctxReported running context_lengthReply
2,0482,048LOCAL_OK
8,1928,192LOCAL_OK

Download exact requests, responses and running-model snapshots. The two calls verify an effective setting reported by the runtime. A short prompt does not test recall across 8,192 tokens, answer quality or the model’s full advertised window.

Build a request and read your snapshot

Use the native server URL, such as http://127.0.0.1:11434, without /v1. The controls below build commands only; they do not contact your local server from this website.

curl --noproxy '*' http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/chat \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data-binary '{"model":"ipunk-small","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Reply with exactly LOCAL_OK and nothing else."}],"options":{"num_ctx":8192,"temperature":0,"num_predict":16},"stream":false,"keep_alive":"60s"}'

curl --noproxy '*' http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/ps

Read the row for the exact model you requested. Our API listed ipunk-small:latest while accepting ipunk-small as the request alias. Missing or unsupported context fields remain unknown in this reader. Inputs stay in the current tab; model names and snapshots are not uploaded.

If the value is missing or different

  1. Check the server port and model tag. A request sent to another daemon can have different defaults.
  2. Inspect immediately after a completed request. An unloaded or expired model can leave the models array empty.
  3. Make sure you used the native API’s options.num_ctx. An OpenAI-compatible max_tokens field limits output and does not by itself establish Ollama’s loaded context.
  4. Check the installed Ollama version, selected model and any client-specific overrides. If a snapshot has no context field, do not substitute the request value as if it were observed.
  5. For a clean comparison, unload only your test model when no other work depends on it, then make another bounded request and inspect again.

A larger configured context can require more cache memory. Estimate the model memory and cache on a Mac. It does not make a small model more accurate or override its architecture limits. This guide did not benchmark long-context retrieval, speed or a maximum safe setting for your hardware. Verify GPU placement after changing context.
